headline: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
summary: Meta has open-sourced code for its new Muse AI agent. This allows users to create custom Muse-powered gadgets. Suggested projects include E Ink displays for reminders or HDMI sticks for big screens.

headline: Netflix is pivoting away from prestige
summary: Netflix is ending multiyear production deals with acclaimed directors. This signals a strategic shift away from prestige content. The move impacts creators like David Fincher and Shawn Levy.

headline: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
summary: Apple is implementing new limits on 'full disk access' for Mac. This security update addresses increased risks from AI agents. New controls ensure careful user consent for extraordinary access.

headline: Sling TV drops its one-day cable passes
summary: Sling TV has discontinued its 'Sling Pass' feature. The feature allowed users to purchase daily or weekly cable TV access. The passes were introduced last year but are no longer offered.

headline: Best Buy Has the ASRock Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB Graphics Card in Stock for $740
summary: Best Buy is stocking the ASRock Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU. The graphics card is available for $740. It offers performance comparable to an RTX 5070 Ti at a lower price.

headline: Disney Says Conversations About Buying Epic Games Are Not Happening 'Right Now'
summary: Disney has responded to rumors about acquiring Epic Games. The company states no acquisition talks are 'happening right now.' Epic Games is the developer behind the popular game Fortnite.

headline: Lanterns: Who Killed Hal Jordan and More of Our Biggest Questions Heading Into the Finale
summary: Fans have major questions ahead of the Lanterns season finale. Key mysteries include Hal Jordan's fate and killer. The article explores unresolved plot points regarding Sinestro.

headline: Vibe-Coded Mashup Mods Have Taken Over X This Week
summary: 'Vibe-coded mashup mods' are trending on X (Twitter) this week. Modders are combining decompiled games using AI tools like Claude. The platform is flooded with clips of these unique game crossovers.

headline: Widdecombe suspect charged with planning terror act against Farage
summary: A suspect has been charged with planning a terror act against Nigel Farage. The charge follows an intensive counter-terrorism investigation. Details of the alleged plot remain under investigation.

headline: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat
summary: The G7 plans to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel. This move responds to former President Trump's threat of a US export ban. The coordinated release aims to stabilize prices and prevent further spikes.

headline: Watch: Why has UK diesel price hit an all time high?
summary: UK diesel prices have reached an average of £2 per litre. Petrol prices are also experiencing a significant rise. The video explores the reasons behind these record fuel costs.

headline: Men charged over alleged plot to target Manchester Jewish community
summary: Two men have been charged concerning an alleged plot. The plot aimed to target Manchester's Jewish community. Arrests were made in the Northern Quarter just before Yom Kippur.
